Overview.Name: A Aruna
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Food_Craving: Light food, boiled or less oil cooked with low spice
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction, stay fit with healthy aging
Overview.Preference_Notes: Strictly vegetarian with eggs, lunch-focused meals

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + lightly cooked vegetables
Option 2: Moong dal chilla (2 small) + vegetable filling
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + cooked vegetables
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal & leafy vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & mixed vegetable curry & cucumber salad
Meal_3 (Dinner - light): Option 1: Vegetable soup + egg bhurji (2 eggs)
Option 3: Cooked rice (~150 g) & dal + lightly cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid all dairy products, gluten foods, soy products and sour foods as requested.
Keep meals simple, warm and lightly cooked to support digestion and reduce stress on the body.
Do not skip meals even on busy days as irregular eating can worsen energy and cravings.
Use minimal oil and low spice cooking for better comfort and consistency.
Regular yoga, hydration and meal timing will help improve long-term energy and healthy aging.
